parts.title: Cheaper Beans, Same Price Tag
parts.part1: Coffee beans have become cheaper. But the price tag in a shop may not change right away.
parts.part2: A price index fell 8.7% from the previous month, a report said. Shops may keep their prices for about nine months.
parts.point_one_body: Shops often buy beans months before they sell the coffee. So an old high price can stay on the tag.
parts.point_two_body: You can compare several shops. You do not have to buy at the first price you see.
parts.tension_body: Some experts say prices will fall soon, but others say shops will not lower prices for months.
parts.in_one_line: Cheaper beans do not always mean a cheaper cup right away.

support.preview: Today we look at why coffee bean prices fall while the price tags in shops stay the same for a while.
support.comment_1: Listen for why a shop price does not change right away.
support.comment_2: A fall of 8.7 percent in an index is a big move. Now, why do shops wait?
support.comment_3: Cheaper beans do not always mean a cheaper cup. Next, what can you do?
support.comment_4: You can compare shops before you buy. Finally, one line to remember.
